response.overview: What is choice, and what is change? Returning to the familiar surroundings or venturing into the unknown—these are the questions every foreigner faces when studying and living abroad. As the three-year term of correspondent Chunyang in the UK nears its end, she grapples with the decision of whether to continue with the secure life her parents envision or embark on another restless three years. At this crossroads, the choice she makes reflects her contemplation of family ties, her journalism career, inner aspirations, and personal talents.
